thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 Pager: METRICS_METERING_COUNT_DRIFT triggered (P1) — token-counting pipeline reporting significant drift vs replay baseline. Affected: hosted API + Dedicated. Oncall: @sourav. Runbook: /runbooks/metering-drift
nora: seeing delayed ingestion windows and a handful of customers getting overage flags in the UI. noticed multiple overage emails between 14:05-14:25 for the same customers. not great. :grimacing:
sourav: ack I'm oncall. looking at the ingest consumer now. what's the immediate impact window? any customer-facing spikes?
alex: backlog on the kinesis consumer — lag ~= 14m, a bunch of 503s from transformer service. quick sample from the database:
```
-- sample query
SELECT source, count(*) as tokens_counted
FROM token_events
WHERE hour = '2026-03-15T14'
GROUP BY source;
-- expected total tokens: 12,400
-- counted total tokens: 11,230  (drift: -9.5%)
queue.consumer_lag_seconds: 840
consumer.errors: repeated 503 gateway_timeouts
```
maria: that drift explains the overage flags: UI billing computation is using a mix of new + partially processed windows. we should suspend overage alerts and prep credits for affected customers. cc @billing-eng
billing-eng: prelim impacted customers: cust_123, cust_789, cust_acme. We'll draft a credit for the 14:00-14:30 window once we have definitive replay results. pausing notifications now.
oncall-engr: investigating transformer errors — looks like a recent change to the transformer bulk endpoint causes intermittent 502/503 under high parallelism. I'm going to roll a quick config revert and restart consumers.
sre: rolling restart on metering consumers now.
```
kubectl -n metering rollout restart deployment/metering-consumer
```
sourav: planning to reingest raw events from S3 for the 14:00-14:45 window after we stabilize consumers. I'll start a replay job but will enable dedupe by event_id.
```
python tools/reingest.py --start 2026-03-15T14:00 --end 2026-03-15T14:45 --source s3://prod-metering/raw --dedupe event_id
```
alex: please ensure replay pipeline runs with duplicate-suppression; otherwise billing will double-count. also we need the original transformation mapping (v1) to avoid transforming differently than live ingest.
maria: billing-eng can enable temporary flag to suspend overage notifications and suppress charging for window. I'll assemble a customer messaging template for CS.
billing-eng: notifications suspended. preparing credit batch CSV now. need confirmation of final token counts before issuing credits.
incident-bot: Incident state changed: MITIGATING — mitigation steps in progress. Runbook: /runbooks/metering-drift. Page severity remains P1 until reconciliation is complete.
nora: CS is contacting top-10 customers proactively; some have already opened tickets. we'll offer interim credits and an ETA in the status update. draft is ready, posting to #customer-success in 10m.
sourav: processed backlog dropped significantly after restart, sampling shows tokens_counted vs expected within 1.2% on 14:00-14:15 slice after replay started. continuing replay for remainder of window.
sre: monitoring queue lag and consumer error rates. no new 503s for last 2m. I'll keep the escalation route open.
alex: note for postmortem: root cause appears to be transformer endpoint regression + insufficient retries in consumer. replay will fix counts but we need better white-box alerts for transformer error spike.
maria: post-incident actions: temporary credits + customer email + billing reconciliation. I'll coordinate with billing-eng for disbursement and post message once done.
billing-eng: credit batch ready pending final reconciliation file (will upload to billing SFTP when done).
incident-bot: Closing actions pending: 1) full reconciliation job completes 2) confirm credits applied 3) postmortem assigned.
sourav: I'll own the postmortem for oncall & replay runbook improvements. alex will own the transform consumer fixes. maria will own billing & CS comms.
nora: adding an interim status update to customers now. :email:
(on a lighter note) alex: big thanks to everyone for fast handoff — looked messy for a bit but we stabilized quickly :thumbsup:
